items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: and I'm very proud of him, Jake Wiley from Detroit.

ctx.x: MR. WILSON: Well, Stumpy goes back to those days with the Zach White band, and he was with one of those bands. And then my other trombone player was -- and I'm very proud of him, Jake Wiley from Detroit. He was playing a technique on the trombone that is still in vogue to this day. He was one of the area players, being taught by a man in Detroit, Bobby Byrne's father -- Bobby Byrne, a white trombone player, was creating quite a bit of comment among musicians in New York in those days, he had organized his band…
Yeah. But Bobby Byrne's father, he had a reputation for being a most generous and most democratic man, even more than his son.
